chapter: Ch. 4 (The Anatomy of an AI Workload) — Note † (Table 4-1 economic row)
evidence: Note † (PDF p.99, printed p.75) states verbatim: "The 730-hour volume at the same 92,000 tok/s offered rate would be ~241.8B (92,000 × 3,600 × 730), so the two figures differ only in which hour count is used for the spend (730 h paid vs 173.33 h active), while the token volume is the same active-hours volume in both". issue: Non-sequitur / contradictory referent: the sentence first introduces a hypothetical 730-hour token volume (241.8B), then concludes with "so" that the token volume "is the same active-hours volume in both" (57.4B).
